decisions.label: SAME_OPPORTUNITY
decisions.rationale: Reviewer adjudication: exact role title and Krakow location, same ITDS organization family, and highly distinctive matching client/project wording about a financial-services client and resilient/scalable high-performance GCP infrastructure. The employer-controlled ITDS posting for this role exposes internal number #10203 and matches the same role/project description.

evidence.description: Both source observations contain matching client/project wording captured in opportunity_evidence.

evidence.observed_fact: Senior GCP Cloud DevOps Engineer, Krakow hybrid, financial-services client, matching GCP foundation responsibilities, internal number #10203

decisions.label: DISTINCT_OPPORTUNITY

evidence.observed_fact: Business Analyst - Talent Pool is a distinct role pool for future BA projects.
IoT Specialist (with AWS) - Talent Pool is a distinct IoT/AWS role pool.
